races.paceDynamic: Nakamura will set the pace from the rail with minimal pressure, as most runners prefer prominent or hold-up positions rather than genuine early speed. Breaking Dawn and Stone Bear may track closely, but the lack of confirmed front-runners means Nakamura can dictate comfortable fractions through the early stages. The moderate pace will allow hold-up horses like All The Girls, Joyful Tidings and Unidos to get competitive positions turning for home. This race shape strongly favours closers and hold-up performers who can unleash late kicks against the steady tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Nakamura sets uncontested fractions and the pace stays moderate throughout
scenarios.body: The patient riders on All The Girls and Joyful Tidings can time their challenges perfectly, sweeping past tiring leaders in the final furlong. Hold-up runners benefit most from the tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Breaking Dawn and Stone Bear press Nakamura early and maintain strong positions
scenarios.body: The race develops into a battle between the prominent runners who stayed close to the pace without over-exerting. Stone Bear's recent winning form and Breaking Dawn's class edge give them the tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Nakamura goes too slow early and the field bunches turning for home
scenarios.body: A messy sprint finish develops where any horse with a clear run can win, favouring those drawn well or with strong finishing kicks. The form book goes out the window in a blanket finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Nakamura gets away with very soft fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The pace-setter maintains enough energy reserves to hold off late challengers, especially with Patrick McGettigan's 5lb claim helping. Nakamura's recent front-running experience at this track proves decisive.

watchPoints.text: Nakamura could steal this if allowed uncontested lead given weak pace pressure and 5lb weight relief from claiming jockey
All The Girls and Joyful Tidings are perfectly positioned to benefit if the hold-up scenario unfolds as expected
Stone Bear's recent winning streak makes him dangerous if he can secure prominent early position without over-racing
Breaking Dawn needs to bounce back from poor Leopardstown run but Colin Keane booking suggests stable confidence returning
Unidos has shown concerning finishing problems recently so watch for any signs of stopping in final furlong

races.paceDynamic: I'm Spartacus will take this field along from the front with limited early pressure, setting a comfortable tempo on the soft ground. Rosato, Jampa Ling and Hero Of The Hour are the only other prominent types, but none are committed front-runners, allowing I'm Spartacus to control the fractions. The large field of hold-up horses including The Love Machine, Sayonara, Dervo Annie and Whatswrongnow will be content to settle off the steady pace. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and early position horses, as the uncontested leader will have first run on the field when the sprint develops, while the mass of hold-up horses will struggle for clear runs in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If I'm Spartacus gets an easy lead without pressure through the early stages
scenarios.body: The favourite controls every call and kicks clear when ready, with the hold-up brigade arriving too late on the testing ground. Prominent racers fill the minor placings as they avoid traffic problems that plague the back-markers.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Rosato or Hero Of The Hour press I'm Spartacus early and force a genuine pace
scenarios.body: The increased tempo sets up a sprint finish where horses with early position can quicken off a solid gallop. Those who raced handy avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the hold-up contingent.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely slow and the field compresses entering the straight
scenarios.body: The patient tactics pay off as closers get clear runs and superior finishing speed tells in the final furlong. Dervo Annie and The Love Machine benefit from Colin Keane's positioning and superior class respectively.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If I'm Spartacus stops quickly after setting uncontested fractions and multiple hold-up horses find trouble
scenarios.body: A 25/1+ shot who avoided the carnage and found racing room capitalizes on the chaos ahead. The race becomes a lottery with several fancied runners disappointing due to traffic problems.

races.paceDynamic: Alnofoor will likely lead unopposed from the start with no other confirmed front-runners in this 17-runner field. The experienced gelding has shown pace preference recently and should dictate comfortable fractions without pressure through the early stages. Behind him, a wall of hold-up horses including Prime Sign, Dynamic Force, Verhoyen, and Ukiyo will likely settle mid-pack or further back, creating a compressed field chasing the leader. This setup strongly favours horses that can produce sustained finishing kicks from off the pace, as they'll have a sitting target to aim at and room to maneuver in the home straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Alnofoor Leads Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Alnofoor maintains his recent form and gets uncontested fractions
scenarios.body: The 8-year-old can use his experience to kick clear approaching the final furlong while the field scrambles behind. Recent course winner Prime Sign and consistent Dynamic Force have the class to mount late challenges but may find the leader has stolen too much ground.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes steady and multiple hold-up horses find racing room
scenarios.body: The compressed field will produce a cavalry charge in the final two furlongs with the classier performers prevailing. Dynamic Force and Prime Sign have the ratings advantage while Ukiyo showed good form when runner-up last time out.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If Alnofoor goes too slow early and multiple horses challenge simultaneously
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the horses with recent sharpness and tactical speed will prevail. One Cool Bear and Hooves Your Daddy drop significantly in grade and could exploit the chaos with their 3-year-old allowances.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If the favorites get caught up in traffic or fail to handle the ground
scenarios.body: A well-positioned outsider with a good jockey booking capitalizes on the pace setup. Glen Breeze has shown improvement recently and gets Siobhan Rutledge's services while Livingston Range has Patrick McGettigan's 5lb claim.

watchPoints.text: Alnofoor's 54-day absence could leave him short of peak fitness despite Colin Keane's presence in the saddle
Traffic problems likely in home straight with 17 runners and most preferring hold-up tactics creating bottlenecks
Dubai Opulence, Reponse Finale, Bel Espoir and Monastere all show patterns of fading in the finish under pressure
Prime Sign's recent course success and good ground form makes him the main danger to the pace-setter
The 3-year-olds One Cool Bear and Hooves Your Daddy carry significant weight advantages that could prove decisive

races.paceDynamic: Zodiac Bear will lead from the gates with his prominent style, likely accompanied by Love Billy Boy, Moss Tucker, and Frescobaldi in the early positions. This creates a moderate pace with multiple prominent runners ensuring no soft lead for Zodiac Bear. The hold-up horses Tina's Indian, Cowardofthecounty, and Tolebi will settle towards the back in this small field. This race shape favours prominent runners who can track the pace and kick, as the hold-up horses face a tactical disadvantage with limited cover in a 9-runner field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Zodiac Bear sets a reasonable pace with the prominent pack tracking.
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get first run on the hold-up horses who struggle for cover in the small field. Zodiac Bear's class advantage (OR 103) and Love Billy Boy's return to form combine with tactical superiority.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong with prominent runners going too fast.
scenarios.body: The early pace collapses and allows the hold-up horses to close strongly in the final furlong. Cowardofthecounty's class (OR 99) and Tina's Indian's recent form (3rd last time) prove decisive when getting the right setup.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sustained Speed Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Zodiac Bear kicks clear early and the field fails to respond.
scenarios.body: The front-runner uses his class advantage to dictate throughout and the field cannot match his sustained gallop. Ocean's Breath provides the main danger as the only prominent runner with recent winning form over the trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Lottery
scenarios.trigger: If none of the prominent runners want the lead and they crawl early.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where positioning becomes crucial and any horse can win. Frescobaldi's 7lb claim and Queen Of The Bogs' fresh legs after a long break become significant factors.

watchPoints.text: Zodiac Bear's ability to sustain his kick if challenged - his class advantage only works if he handles the pressure

The pace through the first half-mile - if too slow it helps hold-up horses, if too fast it sets up closers
Frescobaldi's positioning with apprentice Terry Casey - the 7lb claim is significant if he gets the right trip

races.paceDynamic: Voice Of Reason stands as the singular confirmed front runner in this large field, with several prominent racers like Not Just Any Eagle, Just Keep Flying, Slurricane, and Boxing Great likely to settle just behind. With only one true pace-setter, Voice Of Reason can dictate a sustainable gallop without early pressure, setting up a tactical affair rather than a stamina test. The large field of 21 runners will create positioning challenges, but the lack of pace pressure means the race will develop into a sprint finish over the final 3-4 furlongs. This setup heavily favours prominent racers and hold-up horses with finishing speed, as they can save ground and unleash late runs behind the uncontested leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Voice Of Reason gets an easy lead and times his kick perfectly
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows him to conserve energy before quickening, while the large field creates traffic problems for closers. His recent consistent form at this trip makes him hard to peg back if allowed to dictate.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and favours a strong finisher
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses like Alba Chiara and Night Moon can position perfectly before unleashing superior finishing kicks. The tactical nature allows patient riders to time their runs to perfection in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Racer Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens enough to inconvenience the leader but not collapse the race
scenarios.body: Just Keep Flying or Not Just Any Eagle can track the leader before striking in the final 2f when Voice Of Reason begins to tire. Their prominent positions give them first run on the leader without the positioning issues of back-markers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Voice Of Reason goes too slow and gets swamped by the field
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge where any horse with a turn of foot can win regardless of position. This chaos scenario opens the door for each-way outsiders with tactical speed.

watchPoints.text: Voice Of Reason getting an uncontested lead - if he jumps well and settles in front unchallenged, he becomes very hard to pass
Traffic problems in running with 21 runners - hold-up horses like Alba Chiara and Night Moon need clear passages late
Just Keep Flying's headgear addition and stable confidence - the hood first-time suggests they expect a big run
Several horses returning from breaks including Sanctity Of Space and Night Moon - fitness levels unknown
Apprentice jockeys on Not Just Any Eagle and Slurricane in this competitive field - experience could be crucial

races.paceDynamic: Tassarolo will likely set the early fractions with minimal pressure, as he's the only confirmed front-runner in this 21-runner field. Chopsticks may press forward to prominent position but won't create serious early tempo. The large field and lack of pace pressure means a steady, sustainable rhythm through the first mile before the real racing begins. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, as they'll benefit from the solid pace foundation and have room to manoeuvre in the large field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Tassarolo sets uncontested fractions and the pace stays manageable
